decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module with its own product page, it appears sufficiently aligned with the firm's modular electronics business that management would likely tolerate early uncertainty and keep it on the market.

Because it explicitly replaces an older version, this module looks like an incremental renewal of an established product line and would likely remain unless results were unexpectedly far below aspiration.

Although a software proxy is somewhat more experimental than the firm's hardware modules, its standalone presentation suggests enough commitment and strategic fit to justify continued support for now.

The CAN bus interface seems more niche and was only mentioned rather than prominently presented, so its drop risk is higher, but a one-year-old complementary module would still likely be retained absent clear failure.

A carbon dioxide sensor module fits well with industrial and IoT sensing applications, and its own page indicates a meaningful launch that management would likely continue through this early learning period.
As an accessory product it may face narrower demand than core modules, but its dedicated page and close complementarity with the firm's platform make continued marketing more likely than withdrawal.
